fusions.name: Herd Surge
fusions.desc: A stampede of water rolls out from you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. If it hits, every ally near you deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Spattered Cud
fusions.desc: Spits a wad of wet cud that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drinking Circle
fusions.desc: Restores 12 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Its healing rises 10% for each ally near you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Second Stomach
fusions.desc: Each time you regain health, you restore 4 stamina. Once every 5 seconds. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.
